name: Temporal Anchor
description: The Temporal Anchor is a time machine built by Saheeli Rai in Urza's Tower to project Teferi's spirit into the past, powered by the Weatherlight's powerstone.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower to travel back to the Brothers' War to learn how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: to travel back in time to the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Teferi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda lets Teferi borrow the Key, which becomes a component of Saheeli's Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Katilda allowed Teferi to borrow the key for his temporal studies

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, whispering from the shadows, asks Kaya to pull him out because the Temporal Anchor undershot its target.
timeline.quote: The Temporal Anchor isn't calibrated correctly, Kaya, and I think we undershot our target

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaya extends her ghostform over the coffin while Saheeli powers up the Temporal Anchor in a test, but the circuitry fails in a shower of sparks.
timeline.quote: A shower of sparks poured out from a bank of circuitry

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The spirit shoves Saheeli aside, hacks the anchor with a ghostly blade and flees; Kaya pursues.
timeline.quote: The blade struck the anchor, gouging a deep gash into its side.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
timeline.quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi's spirit appears on a corpse-strewn battlefield while searching for the Last Battle with the anchor.
timeline.quote: Teferi appeared at night in a place very much like hell.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
timeline.quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi travels back in time with Saheeli's device to find how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: Teferi enlisted Saheeli to develop a device in Urza's Tower

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Saheeli create the Temporal Anchor to send Teferi's spirit back in time.
timeline.quote: Teferi Akosa and Saheeli Rai created an artifact called the Temporal Anchor

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Temporal Anchor malfunctions and Teferi is flung to Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: he had ended up on Zhalfir

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli re-creates the Golgothian Sylex and, with Teferi and Kaya, builds the Temporal Anchor to find a solution in the past.
timeline.quote: she built the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower .

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The powerstone in the Anchor explodes, leaving Teferi unconscious, and Saheeli stays with Jodah to save him.
timeline.quote: Saheeli chose instead to stay behind with Jodah to try to save him

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Weatherlight's compleation in 4562 AR, the powerstone is used in the Temporal Anchor, where it implodes.
timeline.quote: the powerstone was used in the Temporal Anchor where it finally imploded.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Implosion of the power stone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi Akosa uses the powerstone to power the Temporal Anchor after a struggle with compleated Ajani; the stone implodes and traps Teferi in time.
timeline.quote: The powerstone later imploded, overloading the anchor and trapping Teferi in time.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The powerstone implodes, overloading the Anchor and losing Teferi's consciousness in the timestream to Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: the powerstone powering the Anchor imploded, overloading the device

citation.text: "Teferi's Temporal Projection", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli, Kaya and Teferi install the Anchor at Urza's Tower to send Teferi back to learn how the Sylex works; Sharaman's ghost hinders tests and is put to rest by Kaya.
timeline.quote: Before he was put to rest by Kaya, Sharaman severely damaged the power stabilization subsystem, though Saheeli was able to repair it.

citation.text: "Temporal Anchor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
